security_controls.summary: Short-lived signed tokens with refresh-token reuse detection; passwords stored only as hashes; organization SSO, OAuth and multi-factor authentication covered by automated tests.
Platform-wide and organization-defined roles; a custom role can never hold a platform-wide permission. Resource ownership checks are not yet applied consistently on every code path.
Organization data is scoped to its organization by default and cross-organization access is tested for several core services; enforcement is not yet uniform across every service.
Signed, independently verified credentials on some internal paths (for example scheduler to tool execution); most internal traffic still relies on network placement. Migration in progress.
Security events flow into a durable, append-only audit pipeline with a tested recovery path; audit retention and immutability are partly implemented.

data_handling: Security controls are HIPAA-aligned. OmniBioAI is not described as HIPAA compliant or certified: that requires a formal risk assessment, Business Associate Agreements and an audit.
Data created within an organization is scoped to that organization by default. Public reference databases are shared across organizations by design.

limitations.title: Literature AI indexes are being rebuilt
limitations.detail: Most PubMed domain indexes are being re-embedded to 1024 dimensions; until that finishes, only part of the corpus can be queried.

limitations.title: Scheduled PubMed sync awaiting verification
limitations.detail: The sync schedule was repaired; a successful post-repair scheduled run has not yet been recorded.

limitations.title: Prepared genome indexes cover human and mouse
limitations.detail: Twelve organisms have genome, transcript and annotation files; prepared aligner indexes currently exist for human and mouse only.

limitations.title: Per-service authentication is not yet universal
limitations.detail: The gateway validates tokens for routed traffic, but not every internal service performs its own authentication check yet.
